history.text: how much fried tilapia rice and some veggies should i hit to hit my macro and or whether need ti take protein shake

To hit today's remaining targets you'd eat about 195 g fried tilapia (≈47 g protein), 200 g cooked rice, and 100 g sautéed veggies. That meal is ~690 kcal, 54 g protein — basically fills your whole budget (693 kcal left), and runs slightly over on protein and fat but under on carbs.

No protein shake needed — the tilapia alone covers your protein target for this meal (54 g vs 48 g left). Skip the shake unless you want a bigger margin; adding one would push you well over on calories.
i want to hit my carbs and protein but in the right amount of calories

To hit today's targets on fried tilapia, rice and veggies: 185 g fried tilapia, 160 g cooked rice, 100 g sautéed veggies. That totals ~695 kcal, 52.6 g protein, 54.8 g carbs, 28.5 g fat — just 2 kcal over today's budget with 20.6 g carbs left, but protein runs 4.2 g over and fat 8.9 g over.

The fat overshoot is the fried tilapia (13 g fat per 100 g). No protein shake needed — tilapia alone already covers your protein for the meal; adding one would push you further over.
Hello, I can only eat around 67 g of the tail part

With only 67 g of tilapia tail (124 kcal, 16 g protein), you'll need 2 scoops of the pea shake to hold your protein. Together: 220 g rice, 100 g veggies, 2 scoops shake → 695 kcal, 69 g protein — that fills the whole day's budget with 20 g protein over, but still 1.4 g carbs left.

No way around the shake here — the 67 g tail only gives 16 g protein, so rice and veggies can't make up the rest without blowing calories. Two scoops gets you there.
Around 175 g if I added the head part

With 175 g tilapia (head and tail combined), you'd eat 190 g rice and 100 g of sautéed veggies. That meal is 691 kcal, 55.6 g protein — almost exactly your 693 kcal budget, hitting protein (55.6 vs 48.4 left) with 7.2 g over, and 16.2 g carbs still left. No protein shake needed.
Those, by the way, includes the bones. Ready? So you need to be able to get an estimate of how much lean meat I can only eat from those portions are also based on the grams that I've given you

Yes. I'll estimate the edible meat.

For the 175 g whole tilapia (head + tail, with bones): about 55% is edible flesh → roughly 96 g lean meat. That's ~105 kcal, 20 g protein. Given your 67 g tail limitation, the meat you can eat stays in that 96 g range.

That reduces the meal: with 96 g edible tilapia meat, 220 g rice, 100 g veggies → 695 kcal, 55 g protein. Still fills the day's budget, no shake needed.

Want me to run the exact portion plan with that edible-meat figure?

Meal total: 594 kcal, 51 g protein. That fits today's budget (693 kcal, 48.4 g protein) — using 594 kcal with 99 kcal left, protein done (25.6 g extra... actually you're at 51 vs 48.4, so covered), carbs and fat well under.

Includes the 1 scoop pea shake (118 kcal, 25.6 g protein). With the shake's protein you hit target; without it the plan from the first run gives 475.6 kcal, 25.4 g protein — 23 g short on protein but with 283 kcal still free.
